name: Team heatmap
pitch: Create a weekly availability heatmap from shared calendars.
instructions: Start by listing all calendars to see who has shared them. For each calendar, read the events of the next seven days. Mark each hour as busy or free on a grid. If a calendar is not shared, note that it could not be read and move on. When all calendars are processed, arrange the grids side by side in a table. If some calendars have no events, leave those rows blank. After the table is built, use make_page to create a simple HTML page with the table embedded. Show the HTML page to the person and ask if they would like it saved as a file or copied to the clipboard.

examples.does: list calendars, read events and build a table of busy/free hours, then display the HTML page

readme:
# team heatmap
Creates a weekly availability heatmap from everyone's shared calendars.

What it does: reads shared calendars, marks each hour busy or free, arranges the grids in a table, and outputs an HTML page.

What it needs: calendar connector to read calendars; calendar_list, show_table and make_page tools.

What it will not do: it cannot read calendars that are not shared, and it will not create or modify any files without asking.
